tools.name: preflight_transaction
tools.description: Before signing: simulate one unsigned Base Mainnet (8453) candidate (chain_id/from/to/value/data); inspect call success/revert, top-level destination and L2 fee constraints, Judgment, reason codes and evidence. Free; no API key, wallet or payment. Complete supported EIP-1559 fee_estimation context o

tools.name: verify_transaction
tools.description: After independent broadcast: verify a Base Mainnet (8453) transaction against explicit inclusion, receipt-status and optional candidate-field expectations. transaction_hash is required; default checks inclusion, NOT receipt success. Free; no API key, wallet or payment. Read http_status, response.ver

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "preflight_transaction" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
